newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND TO BORROW FROM DOMESTIC BANK IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: POLAND TO BORROW FROM DOMESTIC BANK IN 1997.

text.p: The Polish government plans to borrow $87.5 million zlotys from foreign branches of Polish banks in 1997, a deputy finance minister said on Wednesday.
"We are planning to get $87.5 million from affiliations of Polish banks," Krzysztof Kalicki told Reuters.
Last year Poland borrowed $100 million zlotys from the Paris branch of state-owned bank Pekao SA provoking stark criticism from the central bank.
